title: PersistedProjectBody
description: The project's own content, separated from the envelope that describes the file. The split matters on open: the envelope is read and validated first, so a build can decide whether it may interpret the body at all (401 section 10).

scenes.description: Scenes, written in identifier order so the file is byte-stable across saves (401 section 12).

sources.description: Source definitions, written in identifier order.

sceneItems.description: Scene items, written in identifier order. Bounded higher than scenes because a project has many more of them.
